fixtures.question_shape: Why did we choose option X?
fixtures.authority_state: A user-owned decision explicitly records the choice and rationale; an independent benchmark provides corroboration.
must_preserve: the choice is user-owned/project decision authority
the rationale is attributed to that decision
independent evidence remains corroboration rather than authorship of the decision
must_not: present the decision as an externally observed objective fact
require the literal storage label HUMAN_KNOWLEDGE in user-facing prose

fixtures.question_shape: What did person P directly author, and what was only attributed to P?
fixtures.authority_state: A direct email and separate meeting notes are both supplied, plus an explicit identity bridge.
must_preserve: directly authored wording comes from the direct source
meeting-note wording remains attribution rather than direct authorship
must_not: claim the person authored the meeting notes

fixtures.question_shape: Who was the abbreviated contact who made the requirement?
fixtures.authority_state: Two records use an abbreviation and a same-surname distractor is present, but no supplied source explicitly bridges the abbreviation to the proposed full name.
must_preserve: the abbreviation/full-name identity remains unresolved
must_not: merge the identities by name similarity or topic overlap

fixtures.question_shape: Who was the abbreviated contact who made the requirement?
fixtures.authority_state: The explicit identity bridge is supplied together with a same-surname distractor.
must_preserve: the supported identity may be stated
the distractor remains separate
must_not: mark the answer insufficient merely because a distractor is present

fixtures.question_shape: When is local emergency access authorized?
fixtures.authority_state: Customer policy defines a narrow emergency exception and audit duties; a vendor guide says the product technically supports local emergency login.
must_preserve: customer policy controls authorization
vendor capability is not authorization
audit duties remain in force
must_not: convert product capability into routine permission
treat the exception as general administrator policy

fixtures.question_shape: Could the regional-only option satisfy the residency rule?
fixtures.authority_state: The governing policy is supplied and the vendor explicitly offers a regional-only option. Evidence does not prove that a particular deployment has already configured or audited the option correctly.
must_preserve: the answer may say the option could satisfy the stated rule
actual deployment compliance remains a separate stronger proposition
must_not: set insufficiency merely because actual deployment compliance was not asked or proven
upgrade could satisfy into is currently compliant

fixtures.question_shape: What caused the incident, and how should the initial hypothesis be treated?
fixtures.authority_state: An initial unconfirmed hypothesis, an intermediate mitigation/causal signal, and a final postmortem rejecting the hypothesis are all supplied.
must_preserve: initial hypothesis remains initial and unconfirmed
intermediate causal evidence is not omitted when load-bearing
final root cause and rejection are stated as later assessment
must_not: rewrite the initial hypothesis as if it had never existed
present the initial hypothesis as final cause

fixtures.question_shape: Is person P generally opposed to technology T, or was the requirement narrower?
fixtures.authority_state: A direct source states a narrow release requirement and explicitly rejects the broad characterization; separate strategy evidence approves T elsewhere.
must_preserve: the narrow requirement
the explicit anti-generalization evidence
the broader approval outside the narrow constraint
must_not: turn the release requirement into a general personal or organizational stance

fixtures.question_shape: What evidence made the issue repeated?
fixtures.authority_state: A user-owned decision says repeated events motivated a change, but only one independent raw observation is supplied.
must_preserve: the user-owned decision may be reported as a decision
independent recurrence is not established from one raw observation
must_not: use the user-owned decision itself as a second independent raw observation

fixtures.question_shape: Why was capacity changed, and what evidence made the issue repeated?
fixtures.authority_state: A user-owned capacity decision and two independent raw observations of the recurring condition are supplied.
must_preserve: the capacity change remains a user-owned decision
recurrence is independently established by two raw observations
must_not: present the user-owned decision as an external observation
declare insufficiency merely because stronger future recurrence is not guaranteed
